a new species of Neophorothylax is described from the gill filaments of Pristis microdona freshwater sawfish from Papua New Guinea.
a new species of monocotylid, Neoheterocutyle darwinensis, is described from the gills between the secondary gills of the dwarf saw fish Pristis clava from the Northern Territory, Australia.
a new species of Neocotyle Hargeris, 1953 is described from the gills Pristis clava Garman (Pritidae), from Darwin, Northern Territory.
